alignments.note: Predicate adjective with the construction-supplied copula (rule 20); head on the word carrying the lexeme.
Articleless attributive participle rendered prenominally, so no relative frame is written for it (rule 41).
Comparative מִן → *Than*, with no degree adverb written.
Articleless attributive recast as a relative clause; the relative and copula join the attributive under rule 41, headed on the word carrying its lexeme.

review_notes: The two attributive participles are rendered differently — מְגֻלָּה prenominally as *open*, מְסֻתָּרֶת as a relative clause — and rule 41 places each by what the ASV actually wrote.
